description: Header file defining the QuicStreamFactoryPeer class with static methods for testing and manipulating QUIC stream factory instances in the Chromium project.

classes.name: QuicStreamFactoryPeer
classes.description: A peer class providing static methods for testing and manipulating QuicStreamFactory instances.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Returns the QuicConfig associated with a QuicStreamFactory.

methods.name: GetCryptoConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the QuicCryptoClientConfigHandle for a given factory and network anonymization key.

methods.name: HasActiveSession
methods.description: Checks if there is an active session for a given server ID and network key.

methods.name: HasActiveJob
methods.description: Checks if there is an active job for a given server ID.

methods.name: GetPendingSession
methods.description: Returns the pending QuicChromiumClientSession for a server ID and destination.

methods.name: GetActiveSession
methods.description: Returns the active QuicChromiumClientSession for a server ID and network key.

methods.name: HasLiveSession
methods.description: Checks if there is a live session for a destination and server ID.

methods.name: IsLiveSession
methods.description: Determines if a given session is live.

methods.name: SetTickClock
methods.description: Sets the tick clock for a factory.

methods.name: SetTaskRunner
methods.description: Sets the task runner for a factory.

methods.name: GetPingTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the ping timeout value for a factory.

methods.name: SetYieldAfterPackets
methods.description: Configures the factory to yield after a specified number of packets.

methods.name: SetYieldAfterDuration
methods.description: Configures the factory to yield after a specified duration.

methods.name: GetNumberOfActiveJobs
methods.description: Returns the number of active jobs for a server ID.

methods.name: CryptoConfigCacheIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the crypto config cache is empty for a server ID and network key.

methods.name: CacheDummyServerConfig
methods.description: Creates and caches a dummy QUIC server config.

methods.name: GetNumPushStreamsCreated
methods.description: Returns the number of push streams created.

methods.name: GetNumDegradingSessions
methods.description: Returns the number of degrading sessions.

methods.name: SetAlarmFactory
methods.description: Sets the alarm factory for a factory.
